note: Entries taken from published papers so the simulator can run before measured entries exist. Additive only: never edits a contract entry. Each hardware record carries origin='published' and a citation; each number keeps the paper's own statistic (medians are not entered as p99).

yan2026_h200_sglang.topology: disaggregated, 3 prefill + 2 decode instances, one GPU per instance
yan2026_h200_sglang.experiment: Sec. 5.3.2, Fig. 5 (right): one decode instance removed for 10 min at 80% of 3p2d capacity, then restored
yan2026_h200_sglang.citation: Yan, Wang, Biao, Chao, Zhang, Cui. Analytical Power-Aware Provisioning for Prefill-Decode Disaggregated AI Inference. arXiv:2609.24639, 2026
yan2026_h200_sglang.note: nominal_w = H200 SXM TDP (700 W), assumed; the paper's configured power limit was not checked

at_load.note: request rate held at 80% of the 3p2d serving capacity; after removal capacity is 5.2 req/s, just below the offered rate

depth_frac.note: ~620 W total reduction / 700 W nominal; net of the remaining decode instance working harder

duration_s.note: queue grew for the whole 10-min removal; median TTFT reached 8.5 s, above a 2 s premium SLO, so premium duration < 600 s; exact value not reported

d_ttft_p99_ms.note: median TTFT 0.7 -> 8.5 s (+7.8 s); p99 not reported

d_tpot_p99_ms.note: median TPOT 27 -> 39 ms (+12 ms); p99 not reported

recovery_s.note: accumulated queue drained ~1.3 min after the instance was restored
